source_ref.production_note: Vertical 9:16 social tutorial. Live-action presenter intro/outro bookending a handheld real-device in-app screen demo. Recurring series format ('토스 숨은 서비스' episode 11). Presenter credited on-screen as 'Toss UX Writer 구슬'. Feature name verified from on-screen captions as 더치페이 (NOT 더페이/THE PAY); whisper text_raw garbled it as 덮이페이.

target_demo: MZ office workers and early-career adults in their 20s-early 30s who split bills with friends
narrative_arc: A friendly Toss UX-writer presenter opens with a benefit promise (protect both your wallet and your friendships), then a continuous handheld real-device demo walks step-by-step through two ways to split a bill: method one builds a new split from scratch (search the feature, enter the total, pick friends incl. manual add, adjust each share, auto-notify Toss users and share a link via KakaoTalk), method two starts directly from a spending-history transaction so the exact paid amount is reused. A live-action outro signs off the recurring tip series.
creative_device: presenter-bookended step-by-step in-app screen tutorial with numbered caption badges synced to voiceover

production_signature.signature_note: Two live-action bookends shot handheld with shallow depth; the central body is a handheld real-device take where the phone screen is the subject, held in the left hand against a warm out-of-focus interior. Continuous status-bar clock (1:16-1:18) across the method-1 demo proves a single real-device take; method 2 is a separate take (clock jumps to 1:21). No 3D wiggle/parallax signature; motion is natural hand sway plus on-screen UI transitions. Metrics flagged high mean_abs_shift_x but visual check shows ordinary handheld drift, not lenticular wiggle.

global_layout.layout_note: Phone (or presenter) is centered; instructional captions sit in a fixed lower-third zone as hand-torn white brush-stroke boxes, each preceded by a small blue circular step-number badge (1-5). Bookend title/outro captions are blue brush-stroke boxes in the upper third with a hand-drawn yellow ellipse circling the key term. Name-tag chip ('Toss UX Writer / 구슬') sits at lower-center over the presenter in the intro.

recreation_prompts.t2i_start_frame: A candid vertical 9:16 lifestyle commercial still of a Korean woman in her mid-20s seated on a low tiered wooden step-bench inside a softly decorated modern office lounge during the Christmas season; she is framed waist-up, centered, leaning slightly forward and looking down at a white smartphone held in both hands with a calm, warm, natural smile; she wears a long structured black wool coat over a bright orange ribbed knit top, with a thin brown leather crossbody bag strap crossing her torso, minimal jewelry, soft natural makeup, shoulder-length auburn-brown hair with wispy bangs; she is a real-talent-type, not any specific celebrity, with an approachable colleague-next-door presence. The set is a clean Korean fintech office lounge: warm honey-toned wood steps with a recessed warm LED light strip glowing softly along the floor edge, a small white round pedestal side table at the left edge of frame, pale neutral walls and frosted-glass partitions behind. Festive decor frames the background: a decorated Christmas tree with red and gold baubles, patterned wrapped gift sacks resting at the base, and a green garland with red and gold ornaments draped along the top of the frame. Lighting is warm and soft: a diffused frontal key around 3000K, moderate fill (key-to-fill roughly 2:1), gentle soft shadows, no hard rim, an overall mid-key warm glow with the under-step LED as a warm practical and the tree lights as small bokeh points. Shot at eye level, three-quarter facing, with a roughly 35mm-equivalent look and shallow-to-moderate depth of field that keeps the woman sharp while the tree and partitions fall softly out of focus. Composition is centered with generous negative space; the recorded on-screen title copy appears in the upper third inside a hand-painted Toss-blue brush-stroke box reading, in two lines of bold rounded Korean sans-serif white lettering, “지갑도 우정도 지키는 / 토스 더치페이 사용법” with a hand-drawn yellow ellipse circling the word “더치페이” (finalized in post but preserved here for fidelity); below her, a small lower-center name-tag treatment shows a white torn-paper chip with blue text “Toss UX Writer” above a solid Toss-blue chip with white text “구슬”. The palette is warm-dominant and muted with festive pops: honey wood (#caa37a) dominant, deep black coat (#1c1c1c) as the dark anchor, amber highlight (#e0c8a0), festive red (#b13b33) and green (#3a7a4a) accents at roughly fifteen percent of frame, with Toss-blue confined to the caption graphics. Surfaces read as soft wool coat, glossy phone, polished wood, clear glass partitions and foliage of the tree; the atmosphere is cozy seasonal warmth with a soft golden glow near the floor and no haze. The overall look is a clean digital 4K vertical social-tutorial aesthetic, natural and unglossy, true to a Korean fintech brand's friendly explainer style, Korean studio commercial realism. Additional craft notes for faithful reproduction: render her as a genuine Korean office worker in her mid-20s, warm and unposed, the kind of relatable in-house staff member a brand would feature as a guide rather than a model; her expression should read as quietly amused and friendly, eyes softly lowered to the phone, lips in a gentle closed smile, with no direct camera contact so the moment feels overheard and authentic. Treat the wardrobe carefully: the long black coat should have a visible matte wool weave and structured shoulders, worn open over the saturated orange knit whose ribbed texture catches a little of the warm light, and the leather crossbody strap should show a slightly glossy tan finish. The wooden steps she sits on are wide horizontal planks in a honey oak tone with a clear satin finish, and the recessed LED strip should read as a clean continuous warm line, not individual dots; let its bounce light warmly graze the floor and the underside of the step lip. Keep the depth of field shallow enough that the Christmas tree's ornaments melt into soft circular bokeh and the wrapped gift sacks read as soft red-and-cream patterned shapes rather than sharp detail. Exposure is bright and even with protected highlights on the white side table and no clipped whites; white balance leans warm but skin stays natural and healthy, not orange. Frame her with comfortable headroom and the title brush box floating clearly in the empty upper third so text and subject never overlap. The mood is inviting, seasonal, and trustworthy, the polished-but-human tone of a top Korean fintech's social-first content team. Korean lifestyle commercial photography, photoreal, 9:16 vertical.

inferred_creative_thinking.persona: A relatable in-house UX writer as the guide, lowering the barrier so the brand feels like a helpful friend rather than a faceless bank.
inferred_creative_thinking.moment: Right after a group meal/drinks when someone has to collect everyone's share.
inferred_creative_thinking.product_role: Hero utility: Dutch Pay turns an awkward money-collection chore into two-tap requests, auto-notifications to app users, and a shareable link for non-users — protecting both wallet and friendship.

inferred_creative_thinking.brand_fit_one_liner: Reinforces Toss as the simplest everyday-money super-app via a friendly 'hidden feature' tip series.
